root.label: Catalina Island helicopter crash search continues

events.label: Catalina Island helicopter crash search continues

slots.name: missing person status
slots.sentence: "The efforts this morning are twofold, so we're still doing an active search for the person who's missing," Coast Guard Capt. Stacey Crecy said at a news conference.

slots.name: death toll
slots.sentence: Police divers have found the body of a patient who went missing after a medical helicopter crashed into the Pacific Ocean off Catalina Island near Los Angeles, bringing the death toll to three while two other people were recovering from their injuries, the authorities said on Friday.

slots.name: search area
slots.sentence: Divers with the Los Angeles county sheriff’s department found the victim’s body Thursday in the wreckage of the helicopter after searching more than 156 sq miles (404 sq km) over 23 hours, the Coast Guard said in a statement.

slots.name: aircraft model
slots.sentence: The National Transportation Safety Board said it is investigating the crash of the helicopter, which it identified as a Eurocopter EC-135-P2.
